holidayCalendarRules.earlyCloseRule: Sessions closing early (13:00 America/New_York) terminate signal generation at 12:55 local time.

deterministicContractRollRules.schedule: Quarterly contracts H (Mar), M (Jun), U (Sep), Z (Dec)
deterministicContractRollRules.rollEffectiveTime: 00:00:00 America/New_York on the 8th calendar day prior to contract expiration (Thursday before 3rd Friday of contract month)
deterministicContractRollRules.discontinuityPolicy: No trade or signal evaluation spans across a contract rollover timestamp.

candleTimestampConvention: 5-minute candle timestamp t0 represents CANDLE START TIME.

signalEntryExitSequence.signalCandle: Candle starting at t0 (spans t0 to t0 + 5m)
signalEntryExitSequence.exitTimestamp: t0 + 10m (executed at close price of holding candle)

sessionCloseHandling.policy: Signals generated on the final candle of RTH (15:55 local) are SKIPPED to prevent overnight position holding.

sessionLedgerRequirements: Must log ALL pre-registered calendar sessions in s10_session_manifest.json
Includes active sessions with signals, active sessions with 0 signals, skipped holiday sessions, and negative sessions

sampleSufficiencyPlan.preRegistrationPolicy: Pre-register exact calendar dates in session ledger prior to acquiring or analyzing outcome data.
sampleSufficiencyPlan.stoppingRule: Must complete evaluation over all pre-registered sessions without interim early stopping based on performance results.
sampleSufficiencyPlan.dependenceEvaluation: Post-acquisition effective sample size (N_eff) evaluated via HAC (Newey-West) standard errors and stationary block bootstrap (b >= 20).
